verdict.rationale: Twilio Video is a programmable video API, and user-configured background automations are a fair axis for such a platform. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: StatusCallback webhooks that fire on Room, Recording and Composition events, plus a mention of setting a callback URL on a Composition Hook. None of this documents a product feature that lets a user set up automations that run autonomously. The pack does not explain what Composition Hooks do beyond accepting a callback URL, so they cannot be credited as an automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
